bandTips.title: Different emotional tempos
bandTips.body: The higher-scoring partner can model shorter check-ins; the lower-scoring partner can pick the topic. Aim for 10 honest minutes, not a marathon.

bandTips.title: Protect the spark you both want
bandTips.body: Schedule desire talks the way you’d schedule a trip — not only when something feels off.

bandTips.title: Conflict skills are uneven
bandTips.body: Agree on one repair ritual: a pause word, a 20-minute walk, then a restart sentence that starts with ‘I felt…’.

bandTips.title: Money is a shared blind spot
bandTips.body: Start with a no-shame spreadsheet night: balances, recurring costs, and one joint wish for the next quarter.

bandTips.title: Social energy mismatch
bandTips.body: Alternate: one hosted or outgoing plan, then one protected quiet night. Name the swap in advance so nobody feels dragged.

bandTips.title: Room to play more
bandTips.body: Pick a low-stakes make night — cook from a new recipe or rearrange a shelf — and treat ‘finished’ as optional.

bandTips.title: Meaning, not dogma
bandTips.body: Share one value each that feels sacred. Build a tiny ritual around the overlap — even a Sunday walk counts.

bandTips.title: Adventure vs nest
bandTips.body: Let the explorer propose micro-adventures under 90 minutes; let the nester veto anything that steals recovery time.

bandTips.title: Feed the shared mind
bandTips.body: Choose one long-form thing a month to discuss — a book chapter, essay, or lecture — and protect the conversation from phones.

bandTips.title: Taste asymmetry
bandTips.body: Give the higher-aesthetic partner a small domain (entryway, playlist, table setting) and keep the rest negotiated, not judged.

overlapTips.title: Your strong commons are gold
overlapTips.body: Pick one ‘very like’ overlap this week and do it on purpose — don’t wait for the mood to strike.

overlapTips.title: You both want desire spoken aloud
overlapTips.body: Try a weekly ‘want / don’t want / maybe’ share with no obligation to act the same night.

overlapTips.title: Shared likes, different intensity
overlapTips.body: For items you both like, ask: what would make this a ‘very like’ for each of you?

overlapTips.title: Partner A’s unique pulls
overlapTips.body: Have Partner A teach one unique like as a guest experience — Partner B samples once without committing forever.

overlapTips.title: Partner B’s unique pulls
overlapTips.body: Swap roles: Partner B hosts one unique like. Curiosity first, critique later.

overlapTips.title: You both value directness
overlapTips.body: Write a two-line ‘fight contract’: how to start hard topics and how to pause without disappearing.
